routingDecisions.decision: Use original ImageGen art as the visual protagonist and keep semantic labels native in HTML/CSS
routingDecisions.reason: Preserves responsive typography, accessibility, translation, and claim-level editing

routingDecisions.decision: Quarantine NotebookLM claims from the 20 canonical evidence records
routingDecisions.reason: The PDF is image-only and provides no visible primary-source citation lineage

routingDecisions.decision: Keep contract lanes separate from illustrated component adjacency
routingDecisions.reason: Avoids implying an unverified product topology

routingDecisions.decision: Do not report a two-provider multi-AI PASS
routingDecisions.reason: Cursor / Google Gemini supplied one response-observed exact-artifact review, while SuperGrok dispatch remained blocked by provenance preflight

routingDecisions.decision: Separate Photonics power-up read from qualified update
routingDecisions.reason: Two named logical directions prevent the persistence target and volatile source from being misread as one physical or bidirectional bus

routingDecisions.decision: Use mobile inspection tabs with a persistent all-planes scope line
routingDecisions.reason: Condenses page height while preserving that all four assurance planes apply concurrently

routingDecisions.decision: Separate process-device class, embedded-memory technology and system supply contract
routingDecisions.reason: Prevents I/O oxide availability from being misrepresented as the macro external-rail requirement

routingDecisions.decision: Describe 28nm eFlash as a public commercialization plateau rather than a physical limit
routingDecisions.reason: Primary sources and the owner-provided ESF3/ESF2 observation point to mask cost, integration burden, yield learning and qualification as the decisive barriers

routingDecisions.decision: Name the public N5 feature Direct Core-Supply Read and keep Read Availability distinct from Program Availability
routingDecisions.reason: The cited Synopsys evidence is specific to TSMC N5 XHF OTP, while the public owner note states that PGM still uses I/O supply as the charge-pump base voltage

routingDecisions.decision: Describe high-current programming as an eFuse delivery constraint, not a universal multi-pad requirement
routingDecisions.reason: Published implementations prove mA-class current and reinforced Fsource routing, while shared rails show that pad count is an architecture choice

routingDecisions.decision: Treat HBM post-assembly repair as a proven workload and antifuse OTP as a qualification path
routingDecisions.reason: Micron proves repair behavior but does not disclose fuse physics, pad count or whether authoritative state resides on a DRAM, Base or Logic Die

routingDecisions.decision: Merge the Antigravity commit ancestry with the Git ours strategy, then accept deltas serially
routingDecisions.reason: The remote candidate combined useful navigation with release-blocking confidential artifacts, self-cited proof records, unreadable global CSS and standards errors; preserving the validated local tree was the only safe baseline

routingDecisions.decision: Accept only a restrained Portfolio return path and convert the review failures into deterministic gates
routingDecisions.reason: The structural escape path supports the Sam-to-project hierarchy, while provenance, clipped-content, duplicate-ID and whole-page language checks prevent the observed regressions from recurring
